results.name: Excel results for whole-column formulas with data in row 1,048,576 (TT69: #NUM! beyond two columns)
adversary: spill child rows (no input) are counted; ="" in a remote row is non-blank for COUNTA, blank-like for COUNTIF ""
differential oracle: 40 random sparse sheets — whole-column aggregates equal a brute-force computation from the cell list
both evaluation paths: evalFormulaAt (conditional formats) gives the same sparse results as recalculation
cross-sheet: whole columns keep one shape on every sheet (TT69: COUNTIFS / SUMIFS / SUMPRODUCT across sheets were #VALUE!); full sizes still must agree
limits: 16 full columns with bottom-row data evaluate, 17 are #NUM! (documented cap); =SUM(A:C) is fast
